Preparations for the Grand Live enter 
their final phase. While everyone carries 
out their respective roles, they review 
the songs to be performed at the Live.

Light Hello asks you to write lyrics for a 
certain song prepared for the Grand Live.

From the Umamusume running in the present 
to the fans watching over them. Everyone 
puts their heads together to figure out 
what kind of lyrics to write.
